verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a docs entry titled "Webhooks para tarjeta presente", which shows Kushki documents its own outbound webhooks, but only in the card-present context and only as a heading. Nothing in the pack describes the substance of those webhooks. Missing for 10: webhook signature verification, automatic retry policy, event delivery logs, event replay/redelivery, webhook coverage for online/card-not-present payments, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
